rules.rationale: This rule expands the public removeRepeated summary into its accumulator-style removeRepeatedOnto form with an empty output suffix.
This is the empty-input base case of the removeRepeatedOnto recurrence, defining the result to be the supplied suffix.
This is the recursive cons case defining the stable filter: it conditionally retains the head when its original-list count is one and recurs on the tail.
